record.field: nssf = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_nssf') # Tier I: 6% of pensionable earnings up to the Lower Earnings Limit. result = -min(max(contract.wage, 0.0), nssf['lel']) * nssf['rate']

nssf = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_nssf') # Tier II: 6% of pensionable earnings above LEL up to UEL (may be # contracted out to an approved scheme; Tier I always goes to NSSF). result = -max(min(contract.wage, nssf['uel']) - nssf['lel'], 0.0) * nssf['rate']

pension_cap = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_pension_cap') mortgage_cap = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_mortgage_cap') post_med_cap = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_post_med_cap') # Pension deduction = min(voluntary + NSSF, monthly cap, 30% of pensionable). # v1: pensionable == contract.wage (no allowance rules yet); revisit with allowance rules. # ke_pension holds voluntary pension EXCLUDING NSSF (NSSF added automatically); entering total pension double-counts NSSF. pensionable = contract.wage pension_ded = min(contract.ke_pension - categories.KE_NSSF, pension_cap['monthly'], 0.3 * pensionable) result = categories.GROSS + categories.KE_SHIF + categories.KE_AHL - pension_ded - min(contract.ke_mortgage, mortgage_cap) - min(contract.ke_post_med, post_med_cap)

bands = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_paye_bands') disability = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_disability') taxable = KE_TAXABLE # Disability exemption needs a valid certificate: first ke_disability of taxable pay is exempt. if contract.ke_disabled and contract.ke_disability_cert: taxable = max(KE_TAXABLE - disability, 0.0) # Non-resident employees get no reliefs and no pension/mortgage/post-med deduction. # KE_TAXABLE already deducted all three, so add those three deductions back here. nonresident = bool(contract.ke_nonresident) if nonresident: pension_cap = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_pension_cap') mortgage_cap = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_mortgage_cap') post_med_cap = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_post_med_cap') pension_ded = min(contract.ke_pension - categories.KE_NSSF, pension_cap['monthly'], 0.3 * contract.wage) taxable = taxable + pension_ded + min(contract.ke_mortgage, mortgage_cap) + min(contract.ke_post_med, post_med_cap) tax = 0.0 base = 0.0 for width, rate in bands: w = width if width > 0 else float('inf') chunk = min(max(taxable - base, 0.0), w) tax += chunk * rate base += w if taxable <= base: break # Gross band tax. Personal + insurance reliefs are child rules # (KE_RELIEF_PERS / KE_RELIEF_INS) so each relief shows on the slip; # the KE_PAYE category total stays the net tax payable. result = -tax

# Personal relief credit, child of KE_PAYE. Applied relief can never # exceed the gross band tax of the parent rule. gross_tax = -KE_PAYE entitlement = 0.0 if not contract.ke_secondary and not bool(contract.ke_nonresident): entitlement = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_personal_relief') result = min(entitlement, max(gross_tax, 0.0))

# Insurance relief credit (15% of life/health/edu premiums, capped), # child of KE_PAYE. Applies only to what the personal relief left: # applied relief can never exceed gross tax minus KE_RELIEF_PERS. gross_tax = -KE_PAYE pers_applied = KE_RELIEF_PERS entitlement = 0.0 if not contract.ke_secondary and not bool(contract.ke_nonresident): ins = payslip.ke_get_param('ke_insurance') entitlement = min(ins['rate'] * (contract.ke_insurance_life + contract.ke_insurance_health + contract.ke_insurance_edu), ins['monthly_max']) result = min(entitlement, max(gross_tax - pers_applied, 0.0))
result = categories.GROSS + categories.KE_NSSF + categories.KE_SHIF + categories.KE_AHL + categories.KE_PAYE + categories.KE_HELB

# Informational only: employer fringe benefit tax is computed off-slip at # 30% x (mkt - contract.ke_loan_rate) x contract.ke_loan_balance / 12. # No ke_get_param lookup here on purpose: fringe rates are seeded from # 2026 only, and this info rule must stay 0.0 on every slip, including # pre-2026 periods (a lookup would raise UserError there). result = 0.0
